         yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs></note>
<note type="editorial">See rNgog Lo tsā ba's <mentioned>rNam bshad</mentioned> (ID:6121) 95,12-14 des na ma 'khrul pa'i don ni | yul bden par yod pa tsam yin la | de yang gzung yul la ma 'khrul pa dang | mi slu ba gnyi ga la khyab par byed pa yin te | des na myi slu ba'i chos yin no ||. According to Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 182,14-15 the definition of "ma 'khrul pa" in terms of "gzung yul ma 'khrul" is accepted by gTsang nag pa, and the one in terms of "yul bden pa dang ldan pa" by Bram ze chen po (= Śaṅkaranandana (ID:5552)).</note> na re ma 'khrul pa'i don ni gzung yul la ma 'khrul ba dang | 'jug <lb n="25b9"/> yul la ma 'khrul pa gang yang ma yin gyi yul bden pa dang ldan pa tsam yin no zhes zer ba yang 
mi rigs te | gzung yul bden pa ni don byed nus pa yin la 'jug yul bden pa ni gnod med du bden pa yin na de gnyis la spyi ldog bden pa med pa'i phyir yul bden pa zhes pa'i spyi ldog kyang yod pa ma yin no || de lta ma yin te mngon sum yul tsam la ltos nas rtsi na sgra don yang rang rig mngon sum gyi yul tsam yin zhing 'jug <lb n="26a1"/> yul bden pa yin pas bden pa tsam yang yin pa'i phyir de la ltos nas kyang mngon sum du thal lo ||</seg></TEI>
